title: ToolDescriptor
description: Describes a tool capability exposed to agents. The orchestrator enforces allow-lists per agent role + skill using this metadata.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema for the tool args object.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema for the tool result object.

permissions_required.description: Capability tokens the calling agent/skill must hold, e.g. fs.read:/repo, shell.exec:git, phone.call.outbound.

voice_safe.description: If true, may be invoked inline during a voice call without spoken consent. Only side_effect none|read may be voice_safe.
